name: Madagascar

latest_census.notes: RGPH-3 (Troisième Recensement Général de la Population et de l'Habitation), enumerated May-June 2018; definitive results 2020, thematic reports 2021. Previous: RGPH-2 1993, RGPH-1 1975. Ethnicity: recalled with reasonable confidence as not asked -- no post-independence Malagasy census has collected or published ethnic group, which is why the Factbook's national row is free text and the '18 ethnic groups' shares in circulation are colonial-era; verify against the RGPH-3 questionnaire ('questionnaire ménage') on instat.mg before declaring. Religion: I cannot recall a religion item, and the RGPH-3 thematic report list I remember (état et structure, migration, éducation, activité économique, fécondité, mortalité, nuptialité, ménages et habitat, handicap) has no religion theme -- but I cannot rule it out, so null. Language: null (Malagasy is near-universal; no item recalled). The packet's national religion row is a survey/estimate, not census.

already_in_map: admin1 18/22 religion and ethnicity from Afrobarometer Round 9 (survey). The survey's 20 rows are regions (incl. 'Vatovavy' and 'Fitovinany' separately, post-2021 split; the boundary's 22 predate it with one 'Vatovavy-Fitovinany'), and the four unfilled are probably spelling: 'Amoron'i Mania', 'DIANA', 'SAVA', 'Matsiatra Ambony' (= Haute Matsiatra) and the Vatovavy/Fitovinany pair. admin2 (119) holds nothing.

subnational_sources.title: Enquête Démographique et de Santé Madagascar 2021 (MDHS 2021) and EDSMD-IV 2008-09 final reports: religion of respondents by region
subnational_sources.evidence: Recalled: DHS Madagascar background characteristics include religion; a survey, ranked below any count, but of respondents rather than a 40-person stratum.

subnational_sources.matches_boundary_level: admin1 and admin2 -- both exact (119 districts)
subnational_sources.confidence: high that it exists; not a composition source
subnational_sources.evidence: Recalled: denominators and the exact region/district spellings; INSTAT posted the definitive-results tables as Excel.

subnational_sources.evidence: Recalled that Madagascar 1993 is in IPUMS-I; which items it carries I cannot recall.

secondary_routes.hdx: Not recorded in the repo's USCB enumeration; the runner searches HDX itself.
secondary_routes.other: INSTAT's RGPH-3 pages (instat.mg) carry the questionnaire and the thematic report list; that page settles all three 'asks' columns.

tier_reason: Could not establish from memory that RGPH-3 2018 asks religion; fairly sure it does not ask ethnicity and unsure about language. If the questionnaire has no religion item this is a C for all three; if it does, the definitive-results series (partly xlsx) would make it A or B.
recommended_action: Read the RGPH-3 questionnaire and thematic-report list on instat.mg. If there is no religion/ethnicity/language item, declare all three not_collected citing the questionnaire and leave the Afrobarometer rows as the only subnational figure (adding aliases for the four unmatched regions). If a religion item exists, look for a region and district tabulation in the definitive results (119 districts = admin2 exactly).
not_found: whether the RGPH-3 questionnaire has a religion item
any census publication of religion by region or district
summary: Madagascar's 2018 census (RGPH-3) almost certainly did not ask ethnicity -- no post-independence census has -- and I cannot recall a religion or language item either, so the honest answer is D pending a read of the INSTAT questionnaire, with C the likely outcome. The boundary's 22 admin1 and 119 admin2 match the regions and districts exactly, so if a religion table exists it joins cleanly. Meanwhile the Afrobarometer survey fills 18 regions and four more would join with spelling aliases; DHS 2021 tabulates religion by region as a better survey.
